text_original: Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Reviewer states the E450 rides smoothly and the optional Airmatic air suspension gives a serene ride, one reason to pick it over the 540i. Reviewer praises the E450's 375-hp mild-hybrid inline-six and rates it on par with the 540i (both 0-60 mph in 4.4 s), though the BMW has more torque. Reviewer states the E450's 9-speed automatic could be quicker to downshift. Reviewer notes the E450 is rated 25 mpg combined versus 28 mpg for the 540i. Reviewer rates the E-Class interior as more visually striking and of better material quality than the 5 Series. Reviewer credits the E-Class with an optional front-passenger display next to its 14.4-inch touchscreen. Reviewer credits the BMW with keeping a physical rotary controller, which the touchscreen-based E-Class lacks. Reviewer notes the E-Class trunk is much smaller than the 540i's (12.7 vs 18.4 cu ft). Reviewer describes both the E450 and the 540i as spacious for front and rear passengers. Reviewer finds the E-Class classier and more sophisticated looking, while calling the BMW's grille oddly large and its exterior hard to love. Reviewer notes the E-Class can be too easily confused with the C-Class or S-Class. Reviewer states the optional rear-wheel steering makes the E450 feel smaller than its dimensions suggest. Reviewer notes a surround-view camera is standard on the E450 but optional on the 540i. Reviewer notes the E450 starts at $73,700 versus $67,700 for the 540i, and many standalone options and packages push its price higher still. Reviewer would buy the pricier E450 over the 540i because it feels like the more special luxury car. Original excerpt(s), from tool summaries: «distinctly serene ride» «feels like the more special luxury car»

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Reviewer states the 540i felt a size too big next to the E450 and its smaller glass area makes the BMW cabin feel more confining. Reviewer states both cars ride supplely, but the E450's optional adaptive dampers can be set softer, which suits rough Michigan roads better. Reviewer states the 540i feels heavier than the Mercedes (it weighs 101 lb more) and its steering is light on effort and feedback.
